text: Official command-line tool installed via cargo
quote: cargo install proa-cli --locked

text: Scaffold a minimal Axum-backed app with one CLI command
quote: A minimal Axum-backed application with the core boundaries in place: proa new site hello-proa --yes

text: Kitchen-sink ORIGIN starter template that exercises the whole framework as a production-style example app
quote: proa new site origin-atlas --template origin --yes ... This scaffolds ORIGIN, a live routing atlas that exercises the whole framework

text: Dev server runs on localhost and restarts automatically when Rust, style, or config files change
quote: starts the Axum server on http://localhost:3000, and restarts when Rust, style, or config files change

text: Stylesheet edits apply live without navigation, keeping scroll position and form state
quote: Stylesheet edits are applied without navigating, which keeps scroll position and form state.

text: CLI command vendors UI component source into your project so you own and edit it
quote: `proa ui add button` vendors the source into `src/components/` where you own and edit it like any other file

text: First-party Shadcn-style UI component library in typed Rust that you can theme and compose
quote: Proa UI offers Shadcn style Proa components. Source in your repo, in typed Rust. Theme it, compose it, ship it.

text: Accordion component with a CSS-only build that ships no JavaScript
quote: Single or multiple open panels, with a CSS-only build that ships no JavaScript at all.

text: Area, bar, line, donut, and stacked charts rendered as pure SVG on the server
quote: Area, bar, line, donut, and stacked series drawn as pure SVG on the server.

text: Built-in routing with routes registered in a generator-maintained routes file
quote: Register it in `src/routes.rs`, between the markers the generator maintains

text: CLI command to inspect the app's route table
quote: Check the route table: proa site routes

text: Per-route page caching that emits CDN cache headers
quote: Add page caching to the route spec when the response should carry CDN cache headers.

text: Lint mode flags performance problems like intermediate strings, avoidable allocations, and async renderers that never await
quote: `--deny warnings` catches performance problems such as intermediate rendered strings, avoidable allocations, and async renderers that never await

text: Template formatter that checks the canonical layout and verifies formatting preserves the rendered output
quote: `proa fmt --check --verify` checks the canonical template layout and verifies that formatting would preserve the rendered output

text: One typed component can render to HTML, Markdown, and other targets
quote: HTML, Markdown, and other render targets, from one typed component.

text: Optional html-to-markdown feature derives a component's Markdown rendering from its HTML
quote: enable the core crate's `html-to-markdown` feature and delegate with `proa_core::to_markdown(self).render_md(cx)`

text: Template macro validates templates at compile time, merges static markup, and escapes dynamic slots correctly
quote: The macro validates the template at compile time, consolidates adjacent static markup, and preserves the correct escaping behavior for dynamic slots.

text: Components with signals and event handlers become interactive islands, emitting server HTML plus only that island's JS
quote: Add signals and event handlers, and Proa emits the server-rendered HTML plus the JavaScript required for that island

text: Hydrated islands ship a small vanilla-JS module and seed state on a shared runtime of about 1.3 KB gzipped
quote: Each hydrated RSJS island emits a small vanilla-JS module plus seed state, served with a shared runtime around 1.3 KB gzipped.

text: Stream HTML in document order, or let Suspense boundaries stream ready chunks out of order
quote: Flush HTML in document order when sequence matters, or let Suspense boundaries stream ready chunks out of order when slow data should not block the page.

text: Typed WebContext gives every render request-scoped data, response metadata, route state, and loader caching
quote: Every render has typed access to request-scoped data, response metadata, route state, and loader caching through the same WebContext

text: Adopt incrementally by proxying a single route to Proa while the rest stays on Next.js or Rails
quote: Proxy one route to Proa, leave the rest on Next.js or Rails, then compare latency and cost in production.

text: Use Proa Axum-natively, or call it over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby, or Java
quote: Go Axum-native for Proa routing and responses, or call Proa over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby, or Java.

text: Core can be adapted to other HTTP servers or runtimes
quote: Adapt Proa to another HTTP server or runtime | proa_framework_core

text: WCAG and WAI-ARIA checks run during cargo build, so markup defects fail before deploy
quote: WCAG and WAI-ARIA checks run during cargo build so common markup defects fail before deploy.

text: Built-in security: auto-escaped output, cross-origin request protection, security headers, and fixed-upstream proxying
quote: Auto-escaped output, cross-origin request protection, security headers, and fixed-upstream proxying are part of the framework surface.

text: New projects get an AGENTS.md describing project shape, render rules, validation commands, and safe edit boundaries
quote: Keep AGENTS.md at the project root. It describes the local project shape, render rules, validation commands, and safe edit boundaries.

text: Portable agent rules let Proa authoring guidance follow an AI agent across projects
quote: Use one when you want the Proa authoring rules to follow the agent across projects.

text: Every docs page is available as Markdown
quote: Every docs route exposes Markdown: curl https://proa.so/docs/agents.md

text: Full documentation served at /llms-full.txt for agent consumption
quote: The complete documentation is served at /llms-full.txt for agent consumption.

text: Editor tooling adds go-to-definition, hover, completion, rename, and semantic highlighting inside md! templates
quote: Proa's editor tools add Rust go-to-definition, hover, completion, rename, and semantic highlighting inside raw-string `md!` and `md_sync!` templates

text: Editor flags a missing field in the paired Markdown view when HTML changes, even if that file isn't open
quote: Adding a field or child to HTML can immediately flag its absence in a paired Markdown view, including when that view is not open.

text: Component props are checked at compile time
quote: the fields passed to AboutPage are compile-time-checked props.

text: CLI self-update command, with an option to check for the latest stable version first
quote: Once installed, update with proa update, or preview the latest stable version with proa update --check.

text: Benchmarks published with raw JSON captures and commands to reproduce them on your own hardware
quote: every raw JSON capture, and the commands to reproduce all of it on your own hardware are documented in Proa-Labs/proa-benchmarks.
